title: Answer: spacetime, its laws and quantum mechanics are emergent

statements.text: Spacetime and the laws of physics in spacetime emerge from the primal invariant set geometry. Quantum mechanics emerges as the singular limit of the finite theory, and particle properties such as the de Broglie relations from the helical geometry of trajectories near spacetime.
